newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish regulatory board suspends two brokerages.
newsitem.headline: Turkish regulatory board suspends two brokerages.

text.p: Turkey's regulatory Capital Markets Board (SPK) said on Monday it halted the trading activities of brokerages houses Ali Alpay Menkul Degerler and Tan Menkul Degerler due to irregularities found during inspections.
It gave them one month to raise their capitals to 125 billion lira and block 100 billion of the new capital at central depositary Takasbank in the form of state securities.

The SPK said in a statement that irregularities were detected in accounting and registration of share transactions made by Ali Alpay brokerage and both brokerages worked with persons who illegaly ran a share trading agency without the SPK's permisson.
The capitals of Ali Alpay and Tan Menkul stand at 10 billion lira.
